dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: So, Nam, what has surprised you most about Canada?
dialogue.reading: soʊ, ˈnɑːm, ˈwʌt hæz sərˈpraɪzd juː ˈmoʊst əˈbaʊt ˈkænədə?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I was surprised by how polite people were. They say "sorry" all the time, even when you walk into them!
dialogue.reading: aɪ wʌz sərˈpraɪzd baɪ ˈhaʊ pəˈlaɪt ˈpiːpəl ˈwɜːr. ðeɪ ˈseɪ ˈsɑːri ˈɔːl ðə ˈtaɪm, ˈiːvən wɛn juː ˈwɔːk ˈɪntuː ðɛm!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Ha! That's very Canadian. What else?
dialogue.reading: ˈhɑː! ðæts ˈvɛri kəˈneɪdiən. ˈwʌt ˈɛls?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It surprised me that Toronto is so multicultural. In my class, there are students from fifteen countries.
dialogue.reading: ɪt sərˈpraɪzd miː ðæt təˈrɑːntoʊ ɪz soʊ ˌmʌltiˈkʌltʃərəl. ɪn maɪ ˈklæs, ðɛr ər ˈstuːdənts frəm ˌfɪfˈtiːn ˈkʌntriz.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes, it's one of the most diverse cities in the world. About half of the people here were born in another country.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ɪts ˈwʌn əv ðə ˈmoʊst daɪˈvɜːrs ˈsɪtiz ɪn ðə ˈwɜːrld. əˈbaʊt ˈhæf əv ðə ˈpiːpəl ˈhɪr wɜːr ˈbɔːrn ɪn əˈnʌðər ˈkʌntri.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Wow. And people are very welcoming. My neighbors invited me to dinner in my first week.
dialogue.reading: ˈwaʊ. ənd ˈpiːpəl ər ˈvɛri ˈwɛlkəmɪŋ. maɪ ˈneɪbərz ɪnˈvaɪtɪd miː tə ˈdɪnər ɪn maɪ ˈfɜːrst ˈwiːk.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: That's nice. Do you think Canadians are straightforward?
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈnaɪs. duː juː ˈθɪŋk kəˈneɪdiənz ər ˌstreɪtˈfɔːrwərd?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, quite. They say what they think. Thais are more indirect.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ˈkwaɪt. ðeɪ ˈseɪ ˈwʌt ðeɪ ˈθɪŋk. ˈtaɪz ər ˈmɔːr ˌɪndəˈrɛkt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: But some Canadians are quite reserved at first.
dialogue.reading: bʌt sʌm kəˈneɪdiənz ər ˈkwaɪt rɪˈzɜːrvd ət ˈfɜːrst.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's true. I was surprised how quiet people were on the subway. No one talks!
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈtruː. aɪ wʌz sərˈpraɪzd ˈhaʊ ˈkwaɪət ˈpiːpəl wɜːr ɑːn ðə ˈsʌbweɪ. ˈnoʊ ˌwʌn ˈtɔːks!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: That's because everyone is tired after work!
dialogue.reading: ðæts bɪˈkɔːz ˈɛvriwʌn ɪz ˈtaɪərd ˈæftər ˈwɜːrk!
